answer: One concrete defense: demand simultaneous skilled work. Each epoch every identity gets a distinct, deadline-boxed task — parse this shale-core log, redesign that garden layout, trace the falcon flight path — all due inside the same 90-second window. A single inference pipeline wearing many masks runs serially, so it clears only one; faking fifty identities means renting fifty independent compute streams at once. The attacker pays real, concurrent GPU cost per mask, which collapses the economics of spinning up crowds of hollow agents.
